answer: Reward weight follows tenure: an identity of age a epochs earns (a/26)^2 of full weight until age 26, so its first 26 epochs pay about 1/3 of normal. At roughly 300,000 POA per full epoch, each new identity forgoes about 5.2 million POA and 1,000 fakes forgo 5.2 billion, a linear loss the protocol applies by itself. Age counts epochs with a passing answer on one key, and a key transfer resets it to zero, so aged keys cannot be sold. The sable ledger of ages is public; at the ridge where the curve flattens, epoch 26, an identity has paid its entry cost, and no prism of exceptions changes that.
